name: VibeCoded Orchestrator
_min_upgradable_from_doc: v0.2.60: the oldest installed version the orchestrator can update IN-PLACE from. installed < this floor → the update engine routes to the guided hard-cut (git-bundle backup + git reset --hard + reinstall, preserving ~/.vct DBs + Weaviate vectors + knowledge/ + .claude/state/) instead of an in-place pull. INERT at '0.0.0' (no real install is below it, so the hard-cut never triggers) until v0.3.0 raises it to declare the first real hard-cut boundary. See vco_lib/hard_cut.py + the perform_hard_cut Tauri command.
description: The core: 36 hooks, 44 bundled agents, 53 skills, KG + Code Graph, 4 MCP servers in ~/.claude.json (weaviate-kg + search enabled per project; mermaid + excalidraw registered but project-default-disabled until opt-in) + playwright via npx. Runs locally in Podman/Docker.
_install_runtime_doc: v0.2.20 (Stream 2 follow-up, 2026-05-19): the orchestrator core is the install ROOT, not a module installed BY the launcher — the launcher is shipped INSIDE this clone. The install.method=local + runtime.type=cli entries below are technically correct but largely cosmetic: the launcher binary IS the runtime, and the install path IS the clone directory. They exist so this manifest validates against the same `ModuleManifest::from_json` parser that the schema-rendered Sidebar uses for `get_module_nav_items`, allowing the orchestrator core's `gui.config_tab` to be discovered through the same code path as any paid module. The slim `OrchestratorManifest` deserializer in `commands/modules.rs::read_orchestrator_manifest` continues to ignore these fields (serde is permissive by default; no `deny_unknown_fields`).

components.name: Knowledge Graph
components.description: Markdown-based KG with typed WikiLinks, Weaviate-backed embeddings, hook-driven auto-sync.

components.name: Code Graph
components.description: AST analysis via Tree-sitter for 10+ languages. Optional Joern integration for CFG/PDG.

_bundled_secrets_doc: 0.2.0 fork-readiness sweep (item H1, 2026-05-08): the orchestrator core declares the secrets the launcher itself manages (PAT for GitHub auth, etc.) so the hub's `/api/v1/projects/{id}/env` resolver can serve them to bundled wrappers without the user having to install a separate module first. Each entry maps a single keychain slot — the hub uses the SENTINEL_SHARED project_id for shared scope (so all base-host projects see the same value) and the OnboardingWizard's `register_github_pat` writes to the matching slot. 2026-05-10 (post-0.2.0 backlog #6): module_id changed from 'installer' to 'user' so the wizard's writer matches the SecretsPanel 'Shared (this user)' tab's UI_MODULE_BUCKET — registering via either path now lands at the same keychain row instead of two divergent ones. v0.2.18 (Commit 3, 2026-05-18): added `openai_api_key` (scope=shared, module_id=user) so the EmbeddingService can resolve it via the hub for every project. Registration happens via `register_openai_api_key` (OnboardingWizard's OpenAI step + Preferences → Special Secrets). Validation uses the free `GET /v1/models/text-embedding-3-small` endpoint — no token consumption, no billing entry.

bundled_secrets.description: GitHub personal access token written by the launcher's OnboardingWizard via `register_github_pat` AND by the SecretsPanel 'Shared (this user)' tab. Resolved by the hub for every base-host project; consumed by `claude_mcp_servers/search_mcp/wrapper.sh` (renamed to GITHUB_TOKEN) and bundled hooks that need to talk to GitHub.

OpenAI API key for the EmbeddingService. Set via OnboardingWizard OR Preferences → Special Secrets. Resolved by hub for every project; consumed by vco_lib/embedding_service.py when ACTIVE_EMBEDDING=openai or as multi-slot fallback.

_gui_doc: v0.2.20 (Stream 2 follow-up, 2026-05-19): the orchestrator core uses the same `gui.config_tab` schema as paid modules — validates that the schema generalizes beyond paid surfaces. The Tauri commands referenced in `action`/`on_change` fields live in `launcher/src-tauri/src/commands/orchestrator_core.rs`. Tooltip strings are user-facing (non-tech audience); keep them mouseover-actionable, not vague. v0.2.23 F2 (2026-05-21): `show_in_sidebar: false` — the orchestrator-core controls are folded into the per-project Settings page (rendered when the active project is the orchestrator-root row). v0.2.24.1 A0bis (2026-05-22): tab renamed 'Orchestrator core' → 'Clone integrity'. Per-project actions (Rebuild KG / Check duplicates / Re-analyze code / Prune stale codegraph) were removed because they duplicated controls already on the KG/Codegraph tab. Diagnostics section (health-probe + open-logs) was deferred to a follow-up move to the Services left-column tab; the underlying Tauri commands stay registered. The tab now hosts ONLY root-clone-specific affordances: Re-detect orchestrator root + Validate clone manifest (the 2 features that don't naturally live anywhere else per the honest scope audit).

config_tab.title: Clone integrity
config_tab.description: Root-clone-only affordances. For per-project KG / Code Graph rebuilds use the KG/Codegraph tab; for service health use the Services tab.

controls.text: The launcher tracks the active orchestrator clone via `launcher.install_path` (cached in launcher.db's `app_state` table). If you moved the clone, renamed its directory, or copied the launcher into a different clone, the cached path can go stale — manifest scanners + the orchestrator-update flow then point at the wrong tree.

controls.label: Re-detect orchestrator root
controls.tooltip: Re-runs the launcher binary's exe-walk discovery (walks up 8 directories looking for install.py + CLAUDE.md markers). On success, refreshes the cached launcher.install_path. Safe to run repeatedly; never destructive.

controls.text: The orchestrator clone has its own `vct-module.json` at clone root that declares the schema for this tab + the orchestrator core's bundled secrets. When the JSON is malformed (e.g. hand-edited and broken), the launcher silently skips it and module-contributed tabs disappear from the sidebar.

controls.label: Validate clone manifest
controls.tooltip: Parses vct-module.json at the active clone root and surfaces any schema errors. Use when the sidebar is missing module-contributed tabs or when the launcher's bundled-secrets resolver returns empty unexpectedly.
